_source: Corrected rewrite of c42a126f 'How TX Reward Splits Work' using only re-checked facts from the TX facts pack (5% community tax, 5% min commission, PSE monthly no-commission, 7-day unbonding).
title: How TX Reward Splits Work

hook.text: Who actually gets paid when you stake on TX?

introduction.topicIntro: Rewards do not simply land in your wallet.
introduction.valueProposition: Here is how TX splits staking rewards, and what is taken out first.
introduction.credibility: We run a TX validator, so we see this every day.

sections.title: The Community Tax
content: Staking rewards on TX pass through a 5% community-pool tax before validators and delegators split what is left.

sections.title: Validator Commission
content: A validator's minimum commission rate is 5%.

sections.title: Proof of Support Emission
content: PSE, the Proof of Support Emission, pays stakers monthly by score, with no validator commission.

sections.title: Unbonding
content: When you unstake, your tokens unbond over 7 days.

conclusion.title: Takeaways
recap: A 5% community tax comes off first.
PSE pays stakers monthly with no commission.
conclusion.finalThought: Check the details before you assume a clean split.

callToAction.subscribe: Subscribe for plain talk on the TX ecosystem.
callToAction.comment: Ask us how the community pool works.
